_: Quality metrics: lower is better. Written only by `ai:quality record` (never raises) and `ai:quality accept --reason` (raises, and says why below). Do not edit by hand.

packages.without-tests.sees: packages under packages/ that have PHP in src/ and no *Test.php under tests/
packages.without-tests.blind: how well a package is tested: one trivial test takes a package off the list

requests.duplicate-queries.sees: per GET route without path parameters: SQL statements repeated with identical SQL and bindings within one request, read from a real traced request to the running server
requests.duplicate-queries.blind: routes with path parameters or behind authentication beyond their refusal, POST flows, repetition that differs only in bindings (an N+1 over distinct ids), and redacted bindings that differ in value but mask the same

tests.skip-calls.sees: markTestSkipped( / markTestIncomplete( calls in packages/*/tests and src/modules/*/tests, per package or module
tests.skip-calls.blind: whether a skip actually fires at runtime, and skips expressed as #[Requires*] attributes or early returns

deliberate.reason: QualityLedgerGateTest skips in a consumer project, where no ledger exists to check; a pass there would claim a gate that never ran
